title: Four evidence layers stay independent
plainLanguage: Original source, editable tracking, human review, and cross-source knowledge are separate layers. Each answers a different question.
purpose: Make the knowledge base auditable and reversible.

rules.statement: Never modify or replace original media because a later correction disagrees with it.
Manual corrections and accepted tracking snapshots remain editable evidence; they are not automatically owner-verified.
Reusable references must point back to exact source, frame, scope, skeleton version, and review state.
External references use the same provenance discipline but remain a distinct authority class.

implementation.futureWork: Apply it consistently to external perspective packs and poser-part tests.
